messages:
olivia: taking over from @maria — quick handoff. Active: embed-queue spike in eu-west1. Impact: regen latency up, error % climbed to ~1.8%. Mitigations applied: lowered max_batch to 8, enabled small-v2 fallback for embed route, prewarm kvcache on eu-west1. Watch window 30m. runbook: https://runbook.internal/regen-queue :white_check_mark:
maria: handing off — timeline: spike started ~02:10 UTC after a large client ingest (many 8k+ sequences). Autoscaler didn't spin up fast enough. I rolled back the canary that had new batching heuristics, that reduced pressure. Logs snippet showing queue depth spike:
```
# tail -n 50 /var/log/regen/queue.log | grep "queue_depth"
2026-03-17T02:09:58Z queue_depth=312
2026-03-17T02:10:34Z queue_depth=784
2026-03-17T02:11:02Z queue_depth=920
```
maria: left a followup TODO -> adjust autoscaler cooldown from 60s -> 30s in eu-west1, and add a temporary rate-limit rule for that client ID (I created ticket INF-4721).
jonas: do we need a config rollback for the batching heuristics across other regions? I can cut a rollback if needed.
olivia: not yet — hold on rollback. The heuristic change looks fine but exposed a corner-case with large-sequence bursts + client concurrency. I'll add a canary flag to gate by avg_seq_len>2048 before enabling heuristics globally.
deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-03-17T02:25:12Z: Reverted canary batch-heuristics -> tagged revert/regen-batch-2026-03-17-02:25 (user: maria).
sara: FYI pushed a tiny PR for a better metric tag in the exporter (adds client_id label) — will help triage similar spikes. @olivia can you watch for a spike correlated to that client? PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/metrics/pulls/212
alex: monitoring — currently queue depth at 22, p95 latency 340ms (was 1.2s). I'll hang on to the pager for the next 25m and escalate if error% > 1%.
olivia: thanks all. Blockers/nice-to-have: need a followup to add avg_seq_len gating and a postmortem template entry (INF-4721). For the handoff: I'll keep the watch and if nothing resurges by 03:00 UTC I'll mark resolved. :eyes:
jonas: thx — if it flares again I can run an emergency horizontal scale with extra nodes from the eu-burst pool.
olivia: noted. last check @ 02:32 UTC (5172509324) — queue length 18, no new errors in the last 5m. Handoff complete to nightwatch. Leaving logs+commands in #incidents for quick access.
